column1: # Columns (TAB separated): section, key or command, description[, kind[, action]].
# kind: copy (default: info only, Enter copies the key/command), term (runs in a ghostty popup), launch (starts a program).
# In tmux.tsv, <prefix> is replaced with the prefix read from ~/.tmux.conf.

column3: Choose a client to detach (prefix d splits in this config)
Go to window N (numbering starts at 1)
Move between panes and Neovim splits (vim-tmux-navigator)
Move to the pane in that direction
Move pane to its own window
Enter copy mode (vi keys, mouse also works)
Copy the command line to the clipboard (tmux-yank)
